

1 -->today i did stm32 project which is diplaying the dht11 sensor data on oled

2 --> and then i tried to communicate two stm32 microcontrollers via spi communication protocol and displaying data on oled 
3 -->sensor is connected to master and slave oled is connected to slave

4--> i did slave functionality on my stm32 cube ide here is the main.c code 

5-->
       #include "main.h"
#include "gpio.h"
#include "spi.h"
#include "i2c.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include "ssd1306.h"
#include "fonts.h"

/* External handles generated by CubeMX */
extern SPI_HandleTypeDef hspi1;
extern I2C_HandleTypeDef hi2c1;

/* Buffers */
uint8_t spi_rx[2];
uint8_t spi_tx[2] = {0x00, 0x00};

char line1[20];
char line2[20];

/* ---- REQUIRED FUNCTION DEFINITIONS ---- */

void SystemClock_Config(void)
{
    /* Minimal clock config (HSI) – safe for now */
}

void Error_Handler(void)
{
    __disable_irq();
    while (1)
    {
        /* Stay here */
    }
}

/* -------------------------------------- */

int main(void)
{
    HAL_Init();
    SystemClock_Config();

    MX_GPIO_Init();
    MX_SPI1_Init();
    MX_I2C1_Init();

    /* OLED init */
    ssd1306_Init(&hi2c1);
    ssd1306_Fill(0);
    ssd1306_UpdateScreen(&hi2c1);

    while (1)
        {
            /* SPI receive 2 bytes */
            HAL_SPI_TransmitReceive(&hspi1, spi_tx, spi_rx, 2, HAL_MAX_DELAY);

            uint8_t hum  = spi_rx[0];
            uint8_t temp = spi_rx[1];

            sprintf(line1, "Humidity: %d%%", hum);
            sprintf(line2, "Temp: %d C", temp);

            ssd1306_Fill(0);
            ssd1306_SetCursor(0, 0);
            ssd1306_WriteString(line1, Font_7x10, 1);
            ssd1306_SetCursor(0, 20);
            ssd1306_WriteString(line2, Font_7x10, 1);
            ssd1306_UpdateScreen(&hi2c1);

            HAL_Delay(500);
        }
    }
